run_fileIOPlugin: run the pybullet fileIOPlugin example to load nested zip files and render an SDF model in GUI mode
load_plugin_fileIO: load the fileIOPlugin in pybullet to enable zip file extraction and SDF model loading at runtime
execute_plugin_command_zip: execute a plugin command to add a zip file IO action for nested archive extraction in pybullet
load_sdf_model: load an SDF model file from an extracted zip archive using pybullet loadSDF and access robot objects
change_visual_shape_rgba: change the visual shape RGBA color of a loaded pybullet robot object using changeVisualShape
